experiences.name: Ybor City Walking Tour
experiences.departs_text: Parque Amigos de José Martí (Friends of José Martí Park)
experiences.duration_text: 90 minutes; about one mile of walking
experiences.schedule_text: Saturday, Nov 21, 2026, 10:00-11:30 a.m. (the date listed as of Sep 27, 2026); History Center tours run on select Saturdays at 10 a.m.
experiences.summary: A 90-minute docent-led walk of about a mile through Ybor City's brick streets, cigar factories, social clubs and 7th Avenue, run by the Tampa Bay History Center on select Saturdays. Advance tickets are required and each tour is limited to 25 guests.
experiences.quote: Guests will learn how Ybor developed as a central hub of the United States’ cigar industry and how it emerged as a rare multi-ethnic and multi-racial industrial community in the Deep South in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
experiences.notes: The page says the tour 'begins at a new location' (Parque Amigos de José Martí); an earlier Jan 2026 listing met at Centro Ybor. Guide for Nov 21: Evangeline 'Van' Linkous, Ph.D.

experiences.name: Downtown Tampa Walking Tour
experiences.departs_text: Lykes Gaslight Square Park
experiences.duration_text: 90 minutes; about one mile of walking
experiences.summary: A 90-minute, one-mile guided walk past Old City Hall, Sacred Heart Catholic Church, the Floridan Palace Hotel and The Hub, covering the architecture, industries and communities that shaped downtown. Advance tickets are required and each tour is limited to 25 guests.
experiences.quote: Learn about Tampa’s compelling history as you stroll past City Hall, Sacred Heart Church, the Floridan Palace Hotel and even Tampa’s oldest bar, The Hub, on this guided trek!
experiences.notes: Oct 10 guide: T.J. Chaltry, a History Center-trained guide.

experiences.name: Oaklawn Cemetery Walking Tour
experiences.departs_text: South entrance of Oaklawn Cemetery, on Harrison Street between Morgan and Jefferson streets
experiences.schedule_text: Saturday, Oct 31, 2026 and Saturday, Feb 13, 2027, 10:00-11:30 a.m.
experiences.summary: A 90-minute guided walk through Oaklawn Cemetery, established in 1850, which the History Center calls Tampa's oldest public burial ground; stops include graves of 13 Tampa mayors, a Florida governor, enslaved people and Vicente Martinez-Ybor. Advance tickets are required and each tour is limited to 25 guests.
experiences.quote: Although Oaklawn is often associated with local legends and mystery, the tour centers on documented history and the lives of the people buried there.
experiences.notes: Oct 31 guide: historian Fred Hearns. The event's venue block lists 502 E Harrison St; the meeting instructions say the south entrance at 606 E. Harrison St., used here.

experiences.name: West Tampa Black History Walking Tour
experiences.departs_text: The flagpole by the Bob Buckhorn River Center inside Julian B. Lane Riverfront Park
experiences.duration_text: 90 minutes; about eight blocks of walking
experiences.summary: Historian Fred Hearns leads a 90-minute, eight-block walk through sites of West Tampa's Black history, including the former site of J. W. Roberts City, the University of Tampa's I. W. Phillips Field and Clara Frye Memorial Hospital. Advance tickets are required and the tour is limited to 25 guests.
experiences.quote: Visitors from outside Tampa will discover how West Tampa’s cigar industry, community institutions and Black residents contributed to the development of the wider Tampa Bay region.
experiences.notes: The page gives the River Center as '402 N. Laurel St.'; the Census geocoder matched 402 W Laurel St. Coordinates here are the park (OSM).

experiences.name: Ybor City Walking Tour
experiences.departs_text: Listed at 1601 E 7th Ave, Ybor City
experiences.summary: A guided walking tour of Ybor City's history of cigar manufacturing, immigration, organized crime and the Cuban independence movement, run by Tampa Bay Tours, which also runs the Ybor ghost and food tours.
experiences.quote: Now one of only three National Historic Landmark Districts in Florida, Ybor City’s unique history will come alive as you walk the area with award winning guides.
experiences.notes: tampabay-tours.com answers curl and WebFetch with a SiteGround bot check (Sep 27, 2026), so facts come from the operator's Visit Tampa Bay listing. Price, times and duration are not confirmed; a search snippet of the operator's FAQ mentioned an 11am tour of about 110 minutes, but the page could not be opened.

experiences.name: Downtown Tampa Historical Walking Tour
experiences.departs_text: Listed at 107 N. Franklin St, downtown Tampa
experiences.summary: A 90-minute guided walk through downtown Tampa's history, including the site of Fort Brooke, Plant Hall, the Hotel Floridan Palace and Tampa Theatre, offered Tuesday through Sunday.
experiences.quote: Come along a 90-minute stroll through the shade and learn why Tampa is one of the most unique cities in America.
experiences.notes: Operator site blocked by a SiteGround bot check; facts from the Visit Tampa Bay listing. Price and start time not confirmed.

experiences.name: The Official Downtown Tampa Ghost Tour
experiences.departs_text: Listed at 711 N Franklin St (Tampa Theatre); meeting point not confirmed
experiences.summary: A downtown ghost walk that tells stories of yellow-fever mass graves, mobsters and murders, with stops at Tampa Theatre, the Sapphire Room at the Hotel Floridan and Sacred Heart Church (built 1860, per the listing).
experiences.quote: Factual stories of history and horror await.
experiences.notes: Operator site blocked by a SiteGround bot check; facts from the Visit Tampa Bay listing. Price, times, duration and the exact meeting point are not confirmed.

experiences.name: The Official Ybor City Ghost Tour
experiences.departs_text: Listed at 1523 E 7th Ave, Ybor City; meeting point not confirmed
experiences.summary: A guided ghost walk through Ybor City that mixes the district's immigrant and cigar-industry history with stories of villains, gangsters and buildings the operator describes as haunted.
experiences.quote: Tampa‘s famous “Latin District” has no lack of strange and creepy happenings.
experiences.notes: The listing's website, yborghosttour.com, redirects to tampabay-tours.com (Tampa Bay Tours), which is blocked by a SiteGround bot check; facts from the Visit Tampa Bay listing. Price, times and duration not confirmed.

experiences.name: The Official Ybor City Food Tour
experiences.departs_text: Listed at 1601 E 7th Ave, Ybor City
experiences.summary: A guided food walk through Ybor City with tastings at locally owned breweries, restaurants, hotels and cigar bars, and visits inside historic buildings; it ends with a cigar and Cuban coffee, per the listing.
experiences.quote: Sample the dishes that tell the story of an immigrant town that rose from a swampy 40-acres to one of the biggest Industry Towns in America.
experiences.notes: Operator site blocked by a SiteGround bot check; facts from the Visit Tampa Bay listing. Price, times and duration not confirmed.

experiences.name: Tampa Booze and Boos Tour
experiences.departs_text: Tampa Bay Brewing Company, Ybor City
experiences.duration_text: About two and a half hours
experiences.summary: A walking ghost tour and pub crawl through Ybor City led by a guide dressed as a pirate; it starts at Tampa Bay Brewing Company and stops at local pubs along the way.
experiences.quote: From there you will walk through the city for about two and a half hours with your pirate guide, making a few stops at local pubs to try and find multiple forms of spirits.
experiences.notes: nightlyspirits.com returns a bot check to curl and WebFetch; facts from the Visit Tampa Bay listing. The listing gives 1600 E. 9th Ave.; OpenStreetMap places Tampa Bay Brewing Company at 1600 E 8th Ave (the coordinates are the OSM point). Price, schedule and age limit not confirmed.

experiences.name: What It Was Walking Tour
experiences.departs_text: Downtown Tampa
experiences.price_text: $15 per adult; children and students with an adult walk free
experiences.schedule_text: Evening tours that begin at sunset, plus some daytime tours; dates on the booking page
experiences.ages_text: Children and students accompanied by an adult are free
experiences.summary: A Black history walking tour of downtown Tampa that visits the sites of Black-owned businesses, neighborhoods and entertainment venues that have since disappeared; most tours run in the evening.
experiences.quote: Walk Downtown Tampa with us and discover the Black businesses, neighborhoods, people, and places that helped build this city.
experiences.notes: Price, length and sunset start come from the operator's Visit Tampa Bay listing; the kids-free rule and day/night options from the operator's site. Neither page names the meeting point.

experiences.name: Henry B. Plant Museum guided and audio tours
experiences.duration_text: Docent-led tour: one hour; audio guide: 45 minutes
experiences.price_text: Docent-led group tours (10 or more): $14 adults, $12 seniors; the audio guide is complimentary
experiences.schedule_text: Guided group tours January-October, by reservation; museum open Tuesday-Saturday 10 am-5 pm, Sunday noon-5 pm
experiences.summary: The museum in the 1891 Tampa Bay Hotel offers one-hour docent-led tours for groups of 10 or more (January-October, by reservation) and a complimentary 45-minute audio guide for visitors exploring on their own.
experiences.quote: Explore the Museum at your own pace with a brochure and enjoy our complimentary audio tour conveniently downloaded to your personal device.
experiences.notes: Group tours are for parties of 10 or more; individual visitors use the audio guide with regular admission.

experiences.name: El Reloj Guided Factory Tour
experiences.departs_text: El Reloj Cigar Factory, corner of North 16th Street and East Columbus Drive
experiences.schedule_text: Offered on select days and times; the factory is open to visitors Monday-Friday 9AM-5PM
experiences.ages_text: Guests of all ages may take the guided factory tour
experiences.summary: A historian leads you through production areas of J.C. Newman's El Reloj factory that are closed to the public, from tobacco aging to rolling and packaging, plus the company's archives. Entry to the factory's museum and exhibits is free; the company says El Reloj is America's last traditional cigar factory.
experiences.quote: Step inside El Reloj, America’s last traditional cigar factory, and learn how cigars built Tampa and made it world famous as Cigar City.
experiences.notes: The tour price is shown only in the booking widget and was not read. The factory also offers a 75-minute Tobacco Tasting Class and a 60-minute Cigars 101 class (same page).

experiences.name: Cigar Hand Rolling Class at El Reloj
experiences.departs_text: The American Room, El Reloj Cigar Factory
experiences.schedule_text: Offered on select days and times
experiences.summary: Sit with J.C. Newman's cigar makers and learn to apply wrapper leaf and finish five cigars by hand; you take the five cigars home.
experiences.quote: Take a seat alongside our cigar makers in The American Room and learn to hand roll your own cigars the same way that J.C. Newman has been doing for more than 100 years.
experiences.notes: Price and minimum age are in the booking widget and were not read ('Some classes and experiences have age requirements').

experiences.name: Raymond James Stadium Tour
experiences.departs_text: Tour entrance between the Suzuki Marine Gate and the Fifth Third Bank Gate
experiences.duration_text: 75 minutes; nearly one mile of walking
experiences.price_text: Adults (12+) $16.56; seniors (55+) and military $12.42; children 5-11 $10.35; 4 and under free; Florida sales tax added
experiences.schedule_text: Monday-Friday at 2:00 PM; booked in advance only (no walk-ups); the next week's tours are posted Friday mornings; tours the week of an event are subject to cancellation
experiences.ages_text: All ages
experiences.summary: A 75-minute walking tour of the Buccaneers' and USF's stadium: a stadium club, a luxury suite, the Hall of Fame club, the pirate ship, the visiting and USF locker rooms and the field. Tours run weekday afternoons and must be booked ahead.
experiences.notes: Private tours need at least 10 people, same price; groups of 15+ must call ahead. No strollers, footballs or professional cameras.

experiences.name: Tampa Sightseeing City Tour
experiences.departs_text: In front of Hotel Flor, Florida Ave entrance
experiences.ages_text: All ages
experiences.summary: A 2.5-hour small-group tour in a 12-passenger air-conditioned minibus with stops at the Tampa postcard mural, Sparkman Wharf and Armature Works, plus Ybor City, the Riverwalk, Bayshore Boulevard and the history of the Central Avenue Scrub neighborhood.
experiences.quote: Explore the great city of Tampa on a small group city Bus tour.
experiences.notes: FAQ: the bus is not wheelchair accessible; tours are in English only; tour guest parking at Hotel Flor is $20.

experiences.name: Cigar City Bus Tour
experiences.departs_text: Grand Cathedral Cigars (pick-up and drop-off)
experiences.summary: A 3-hour minibus tour of Tampa cigar lounges, including Grand Cathedral Cigars, Sterling Cigar Lounge, King Corona Cigars and La Faraona Cigar Factory, with Ybor City history from the guide and a pass by the J.C. Newman factory.
experiences.quote: Tampa Minibus Tours is ready to take you for a taste of the Cigar Capital of the World.
experiences.notes: The tour page says 4 cigar lounges; the home page says 5. Free guest parking at 206 E. Amelia Ave per the FAQ.

experiences.name: Taste of Tampa Brew Tour
experiences.departs_text: Outside the Starbucks at the Hyatt Place, downtown Tampa
experiences.schedule_text: 5 p.m. Fri; 11:30 a.m. Sat and Sun
experiences.ages_text: 21 or older with ID, including non-drinker tickets
experiences.summary: A guided brewery tour with round-trip transport, behind-the-scenes access at 3 breweries, up to 12 beers and a paired meal; sample stops include Southern Brewing & Winery, Cigar City Brewing, BarrieHaus and Bastet Brewing.
experiences.quote: The Taste of Tampa Brew Tour offers behind-the-scenes access to 3 breweries and four tastings for a total of 12 different beers alongside a deliciously paired meal at one of our partners or a local restaurant.
experiences.notes: Capacity 14. City Brew Tours also runs a shorter 'Sip of Tampa' public tour (not read). Closed-toe shoes required.

experiences.name: Spirit of St. Pete Tour
experiences.departs_text: St. Petersburg Distillery, corner of 7th Ave S and 31st St S, off the Pinellas Trail
experiences.ages_text: 21+ to take part in the tasting
experiences.summary: A guided behind-the-scenes tour of a craft distillery that makes whiskey, rum, gin and liqueurs, starting with a cocktail and ending with a tasting of 6 spirits in the distillery's speakeasy.
experiences.quote: Go behind the scenes and discover how we transform Florida-grown grains into whiskey, rum, gin, and liqueurs using traditional copper stills and modern innovation.
experiences.notes: Price is in the booking widget and was not read.

experiences.name: Moonshiners Tour
experiences.departs_text: St. Petersburg Distillery, corner of 7th Ave S and 31st St S
experiences.ages_text: 21+ to take part in the tasting
experiences.summary: An evening distillery tour about Prohibition, bootlegging and rum running in St. Petersburg, with a walk through the (non-air-conditioned) production area and a tasting of 6 spirits.
experiences.quote: Join us to hear untold stories of debauchery, daring, and rum running in St. Petersburg, Florida
experiences.notes: Price is in the booking widget and was not read.

experiences.name: Gulp Coast Craft Beer Trail passport
experiences.departs_text: Self-guided; about 50 locally owned breweries across Pinellas County (North, Central and South)
experiences.summary: A self-guided brewery passport from the county tourism office: you sign up, check in at participating breweries for deals, and collect enough stops to claim a Gulp Coast T-shirt.
experiences.quote: This passport is your guide to St. Pete-Clearwater's craft beer scene.
experiences.notes: County-wide; area set to downtown-stpete only because the schema needs one. The page does not state cost, format or the number of stops needed for the shirt. The Tampa Bay Ale Trail passport (tampabayaletrail.com) returned 404 on Sep 27, 2026 and is not included.

experiences.name: Serengeti Safari

experiences.ages_text: Ages 5 and older; under 14 with someone 14 or older
experiences.summary: An open-air truck ride across the park's 65-acre Serengeti Plain with a guide, where you hand-feed giraffes and see zebras, ostriches, rhinos and antelope. It is an add-on to park admission.
experiences.quote: Trek across the 65-acre Serengeti Plain on an open-air touring vehicle
experiences.notes: Read with WebFetch (curl is blocked by Cloudflare). Vehicles are standing room only with one wheelchair space per truck; check in 15 minutes early; 24-hour cancellation.

experiences.name: Sunset on the Serengeti
experiences.season_text: Select nights from January to March
experiences.ages_text: 21 and older
experiences.summary: An evening package with a Serengeti Safari before sunset, a guided walk to Treetop Kitchen with animal encounters, and a three-course African-inspired dinner with one cocktail. Park admission is not required.
experiences.quote: Experience the magic of the wild with Sunset on the Serengeti, an exclusive evening adventure at Busch Gardens Tampa.
experiences.status_note: Offered on select nights from January to March, per the Busch Gardens page (checked Sep 27, 2026).
experiences.notes: Read with WebFetch. Price not shown on the page read.

experiences.name: Animal Insider Tours and Encounters
experiences.price_text: From $15.99 (Animal Care Center tour) to $69.99 (Rhino, Giraffe, Hippo and Sloth encounters); insider tours from $29.99
experiences.summary: Short behind-the-scenes tours with animal care staff, including cheetah, tiger, gorilla, chimpanzee, elephant, penguin and Australia insider tours, the Animal Care Center tour, and 45-minute off-road rhino and giraffe encounters.

experiences.name: Keeper for a Day
experiences.summary: A four-hour morning working alongside Busch Gardens animal care specialists, offered in Australia, Animal Ambassador and Elephant versions.
experiences.notes: Minimum age not read. Read with WebFetch.

experiences.name: Private VIP Rhino Safari
experiences.summary: A private 45-minute off-road safari on the Serengeti Plain with an animal care specialist, where you meet giraffes and rhinos up close.
experiences.notes: Price and duration from the animal experiences page; description from the tours page ('Meet giraffes and rhinos on a unique off-road private safari'). Read with WebFetch.

experiences.name: SeaTREK
experiences.departs_text: Heart of the Sea habitat, inside the aquarium
experiences.duration_text: About one hour, with about 20 minutes underwater
experiences.price_text: $75 per person, plus a general admission ticket
experiences.schedule_text: Saturdays and Sundays, five sessions a day
experiences.ages_text: Ages 10 and up; no swimming required
experiences.summary: A guided underwater walk for non-divers through the coral caves of the aquarium's 15-foot-deep Heart of the Sea habitat, among Indo-Pacific fish and loggerhead sea turtles. Gear, including a wetsuit, is provided.
experiences.quote: Take an aquatic adventure with SeaTREK, a guided underwater walking tour designed for non-divers ages 10 and up.
experiences.notes: Read with WebFetch. Liability waiver and medical questionnaire required.

experiences.name: Penguin Encounter
experiences.price_text: $75 per person, plus a general admission ticket
experiences.schedule_text: Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays at 1:30 PM
experiences.ages_text: At least 8 years old
experiences.summary: A 45-minute behind-the-scenes session with the aquarium's animal care team and its African penguins, with a close meet-and-greet and a question-and-answer session; groups are capped at 8.
experiences.quote: Enjoy a 45-minute interactive experience with exclusive access to one of The Florida Aquarium's most popular animal ambassadors.
experiences.notes: Read with WebFetch. The aquarium also lists a Sloth Encounter and Stingray Feeding (not read).

experiences.name: St. Pete Segway Tour

experiences.summary: A 2-hour guided Segway ride from downtown St. Petersburg to the waterfront, the Pier, North Straub Park, Albert Whitted Airport, the Dalí Museum and the marinas, in groups of 2 to 8 riders.
experiences.quote: 2 hours of being a kid again!!!
experiences.notes: The site links to stpete.magiccarpetglide.com (the same network as Magic Carpet Glide in Tampa, whose site returned 503 on Sep 27, 2026). Paid lot next door at 231 2nd Ave. N.

experiences.name: Segway tours (Scenic, Historic and Eco)

experiences.price_text: 1-hour Scenic $60; 2-hour Historic $70 (includes museum admission); 2.5-hour Eco $85 (includes Sunken Gardens admission)

experiences.summary: Guided Segway tours of downtown St. Petersburg that start at the Museum of History; the longer tours bundle admission to the museum or to Sunken Gardens. The company also runs a bike tour at Boyd Hill Nature Preserve and a paddleboard tour.

experiences.name: St. Pete Awesome Mural Biking Tour
experiences.departs_text: St Pete Biking shop on the Pinellas Trail at 20th Street South
experiences.ages_text: 12+ on regular bikes; 18+ on e-bikes
experiences.summary: A 2-hour guided bike ride past more than 40 downtown murals, many from the SHINE Mural Festival, with the stories behind them; bike, helmet and water bottle included and parking is free.
experiences.quote: On this biking tour, you will see more than 40 murals and learn the stories and mural-creation process behind them.

experiences.name: St. Pete History and Heritage Biking Tour
experiences.departs_text: St Pete Biking shop on the Pinellas Trail at 20th Street South
experiences.ages_text: 12+ on regular bikes; 18+ on e-bikes
experiences.summary: A 2-hour guided ride through St. Petersburg history, from the green benches and Webb City to the Orange Belt Railway and figures such as Peter Demens and Babe Ruth; bike, helmet and water bottle included.
experiences.quote: Green benches, Webb City, the Orange Belt Railway...St. Petersburg has a rich and robust heritage that continues to influence the community today.

experiences.name: Downtown St. Pete Sights and Murals E-bike Tour
experiences.departs_text: Flora Wylie Park
experiences.ages_text: All ages, per the tour page; call about teen riders
experiences.summary: A 2.5-hour guided e-bike ride along downtown St. Petersburg's waterfront past murals, the Pier, the Dalí Museum and Albert Whitted Park, with a 20-minute coffee stop; e-bike and helmet included.
experiences.quote: Explore Downtown St Petersburg's vibrant waterfront on this 2.5 hour E-bike tour.
experiences.notes: Price is in the booking widget. The company also runs a Fort De Soto e-bike and beach tour. The FAQ sets 16 as the minimum age to ride a rental alone. Flora Wylie Park coordinates from OpenStreetMap.

experiences.name: Docent-led tours at The Dalí
experiences.departs_text: James Family Wing (public pop-up tours)
experiences.price_text: Private tours for 1-30 guests: standard admission plus $100 per docent
experiences.schedule_text: Public pop-up tours of the permanent collection at 10:30am, 11:30am, 12:30pm, 1:30pm, 2:30pm and 3:30pm, subject to volunteer availability; private tours need a week's notice
experiences.summary: Volunteer docents lead periodic pop-up tours of the museum's permanent collection of Salvador Dalí's work during the day; private one-hour tours for up to 30 guests, including themed and foreign-language tours, can be booked a week ahead.
experiences.quote: For something unique, consider the popular “ProvocaTour” which delves into the more provocative subjects in Dalí’s works.
experiences.notes: The page does not say whether the pop-up tours cost extra beyond admission. A free mobile guide (Bloomberg Connects) is offered per the Visit page. Museum hours on the page footer: daily 10:00am-6:00pm, Thursdays to 8:00pm.

experiences.name: Walking Mural Tours
experiences.departs_text: Florida CraftArt gallery
experiences.duration_text: About 90 minutes (10-11:30 a.m.); four blocks and back
experiences.summary: A Saturday-morning walking tour from the Florida CraftArt gallery through the Central Arts District, telling the stories behind more than 30 murals in a four-block area; limited to 25 people.
experiences.quote: Visitors will hear the inside stories of the making of over 30 murals found in the four-block tour.
experiences.notes: The operator calls it 'The original St. Pete Mural Tour!' The Visit St. Pete/Clearwater event listing shows older prices ($20/$11); the operator's page ($25/$15) is used. Florida CraftArt also sells 'Mural Tours by Bike' from $39.

experiences.name: SHINE Mural Tour on Star Trolley
experiences.departs_text: 2390 5th Ave S, Warehouse Arts District (per the Visit St. Pete/Clearwater listing)
experiences.schedule_text: Sundays 10:00 am, every two weeks, Oct 4-Dec 27, 2026 (per the Visit St. Pete/Clearwater listing)
experiences.summary: A 2-hour guided open-air trolley tour of St. Petersburg's large-scale murals, including SHINE Mural Festival works, with the stories and creative process behind them; part of the proceeds supports the St. Petersburg Arts Alliance.
experiences.quote: Experience the stories behind the art, the creative process, and the impact of these murals—all guided by experts who bring the walls to life.
experiences.notes: The departure address and fall 2026 dates come from the Visit St. Pete/Clearwater event listing (read with WebFetch), not the operator page. The listing gives 10:00 am-12:00 pm but also '2.5-hour'; the operator page says 120 minutes.

experiences.name: St. Pete City Trolley Tour

experiences.quote: Become a local in just 2 hours as we take you through 10 completely different districts, from waterfront icons and historic neighborhoods to colorful murals, hidden gems, local favorites, and places most visitors never find on their own.
experiences.notes: Most vehicles have no wheelchair lift; advance notice required. Guests may bring food and drinks, including beer and wine.

experiences.name: Tampa City Trolley Tour
experiences.departs_text: In front of the ALTIS apartment building, Hyde Park
experiences.duration_text: 90 minutes to 2 hours, depending on traffic
experiences.summary: A guided trolley tour of Tampa that covers Ybor City's brick streets and cigar history, murals and the waterfront, with a Cuban sandwich tasting stop.
experiences.quote: From the brick streets of Ybor City to colorful murals and waterfront views, this tour captures the true flavor of Tampa.
experiences.notes: Paid street parking near the start. Most vehicles have no wheelchair lift.

experiences.name: Holiday Lights Trolley Tour
experiences.departs_text: ArtsXchange at the Warehouse Arts District (WADA)
experiences.schedule_text: Three departures nightly: 6:00 PM and 8:00 PM (all ages) and 10:00 PM (21+); check-in 30 minutes before
experiences.ages_text: All ages at 6:00 and 8:00 PM; 21+ at 10:00 PM
experiences.summary: An evening open-air trolley ride past St. Petersburg's holiday light displays, with free parking at the ArtsXchange; guests may bring snacks, and guests 21+ may bring beer or wine.
experiences.quote: Our most popular holiday tradition is back for another amazing season.
experiences.status_note: Runs in December; the operator's page advertises the 2026 season (checked Sep 27, 2026).

experiences.name: Historic Downtown St. Pete Trolley Tour
experiences.departs_text: St. Petersburg Museum of History
experiences.summary: A museum-led trolley tour of the people, piers, railroads, waterfront parks and neighborhoods that shaped St. Petersburg, from Thrill Hill and Roser Park to Coffee Pot and Mirror Lake, run with Star Trolley.
experiences.quote: Climb aboard and discover the dreamers and schemers who created St. Petersburg!
experiences.notes: Date and price from the museum's events calendar. The museum's tours are also listed on Visit St. Pete/Clearwater as 'History Tours in St. Pete' (first Saturday monthly at 9am).

experiences.name: St. Pete on Foot: A Walking Tour of the Sunshine City
experiences.departs_text: St. Petersburg Museum of History, on the St. Pete Pier approach
experiences.summary: A guided walking tour of downtown St. Petersburg led by the St. Petersburg Museum of History, starting from the museum.
experiences.quote: Join the St. Petersburg Museum of History on Saturday, October 3, for an immersive guided walking tour of downtown St. Pete!
experiences.notes: The Visit St. Pete/Clearwater listing says walking tours run the second Saturday monthly at 9:30am for 90 minutes; the museum calendar lists Oct 3 (a first Saturday), 9:30-11:30 am.

experiences.name: A Ghostly Haunted Trolley Tour
experiences.operator: St. Petersburg Museum of History with SPIRITS of St. Petersburg

experiences.summary: An evening trolley tour of downtown haunts and the Roser Park and Old Northeast neighborhoods, led by the SPIRITS of St. Petersburg paranormal group and departing from the Museum of History.

report:
# exp-land: land experiences (checked Sep 27, 2026)

## What is covered
81 operator-run, bookable (or free, scheduled) land experiences across Tampa Bay and day-trip areas:

- **Walking and history tours (13):** Tampa Bay History Center's four Saturday walks (Ybor City, downtown Tampa, Oaklawn Cemetery, West Tampa Black history), with 2026 dates and $25 prices; Tampa Bay Tours' Ybor and downtown walks; What It Was (Black history, downtown Tampa); Henry B. Plant Museum tours; Dalí Museum docent tours; Florida CraftArt mural walk; the St. Petersburg Museum of History's walking tour; The Ringling's tours; Florida Southern College's Frank Lloyd Wright tours.
- **Ghost tours (8):** Tampa Bay Tours (downtown Tampa, Ybor), Nightly Spirits (Ybor pub crawl), Ghost Tour of St. Petersburg, St. Peter's Ghosts, the museum/SPIRITS haunted trolley, and Silent Slayer (Safety Harbor, Tarpon Springs).
- **Trolley and bus tours (8):** Tampa Minibus sightseeing; Star Trolley (St. Pete city, Tampa city, SHINE murals, holiday lights); museum trolley tours (downtown history, baseball, Prohibition).
- **Food tours (7):** Official Ybor City Food Tour; Tampa Bay Food Tours (downtown Tampa, Dunedin, Beach Drive, Safety Harbor); Eat St Pete self-guided; Sunset Food Tours St. Pete.
- **Drink tours (5):** City Brew Tours Tampa; St. Petersburg Distillery (two tours); Yuengling Tampa brewery tour; the Gulp Coast Craft Beer Trail passport.
- **Cigar (4):** J.C. Newman El Reloj factory tour and hand-rolling class; Tabanero Leaf & Learn; Tampa Minibus cigar lounge tour.
- **Bike and Segway (6):** St Pete Segway Tours; Doo's Amazing Tours; St Pete Biking (murals, history); Bay E-Bikes (downtown and Fort De Soto).
- **Air (4):** Tampa Bay Aviation, Vertical Flight and flyVENTURE helicopters; Gotta Fly sunrise balloon flights.
- **Animal encounters and behind-the-scenes (14):** Busch Gardens (Serengeti Safari, Sunset on the Serengeti, insider tours, Keeper for a Day, VIP Rhino Safari, Elite VIP Tour); Florida Aquarium (SeaTREK, Penguin Encounter); Clearwater Marine Aquarium (dolphin, shark, behind-the-scenes); ZooTampa (thin record); Giraffe Ranch; Raymond James Stadium tour.
- **Adventure (5):** Empower zip line (Oldsmar), TreeHoppers (Dade City), TreeUmph (Bradenton), Skydive City (Zephyrhills), Wolfpack ATV (Brooksville).
- **Classes (3):** Morean glassblowing; Zen Glass workshops; DMG Hot Glass Workshop (free viewing).
- **Shows and other (4):** Dinner Detective (Tampa); Zubrick Magic Theatre; Florida Railroad Museum train ride (Parrish); Friday Stairs (free Riverwalk workout).

**By region:** Tampa 34; St. Petersburg 27; Clearwater and North Pinellas 10; Day Trips 5; Around the Bay 4; Gulf Beaches 1. Beach-area activities are mostly on the water (exp-water).

**By status:** 78 open; 3 seasonal (Sunset on the Serengeti, January to March; Star Trolley holiday lights, December; Ghost Tour of St. Petersburg, private tours only until spring, per its page).

## How candidates were found
1. The Visit Tampa Bay listings API: category 4, "Things to Do", 339 listings. I filtered it by the Tours, Group Tours, Team Building, Only in Tampa Bay, Breweries, Eco-Tourism and Family Fun subcategories.
2. Visit St. Pete/Clearwater: the tours, city-tours and event pages (WebFetch; the site blocks curl with Cloudflare).
3. WebSearch by kind and area: Segway and e-bike tours, St. Pete food and ghost tours, brewery and distillery tours, helicopter tours, hot air balloons, glassblowing, cooking classes, dinner theater, ziplines, Busch Gardens upcharge tours.
4. Operators' own tour indexes, which led to sibling tours: History Center tours, St. Petersburg Museum of History tours and events, Star Trolley tours, Busch Gardens animal experiences, CMA experiences.

Every record was then filled from the operator's own page where it could be opened. Coordinates come from the Census geocoder (address) or Photon (named meeting points). Photon matches are noted in `notes` where the match was a nearby feature.

## Deliberately left out
- **Cigar City Brewing tours.** Its FAQ says: "we do not currently offer tours."
- **Tampa Bay Brew Bus.** It ceased operations on May 31, 2026, per search results.
- **Tampa Bay Ale Trail passport.** tampabayaletrail.com returned 404.
- **Show Palace Dinner Theatre (Hudson).** Listed as closed or renamed; not verifiable.
- **Water tours.** Pirate ships, dolphin and boat tours, the History Center lunch cruise and the museum's "Liquid to Land" boat tours belong to exp-water.
- **Unconfirmed operators.** Cozymeal and Classpop cooking classes are aggregator listings of individual chefs, with no fixed operator or venue. Remi's Segway (St. Pete Beach) has a stale site. US Ghost Adventures and Lizzie Borden Ghost Tours were not verified.
